## Où j'en suis
Built Idempotency-Key support on POST /v1/refunds (Postgres store, 72h TTL, migration 0142, docs), after an initial Redis attempt was rejected. PR quillon/core#1437 is merged after Tomer's review was addressed (canonical JSON hash, 409 for in-flight). Work continues on branch jake/refund-idempotency. A read-only SQL query found the 14 Pinecrest duplicate refunds (Nov 12, $3,212.40 total before two partial reversals), with a CSV saved locally but not committed.

- [en-cours] List of the 14 Pinecrest duplicate refunds for Carla; net amounts not yet confirmed
- [prochaine-étape] Verify net amounts with Marcus (2 partial reversals), then send the list to Carla by Friday
- [essai-raté] Redis-backed store: CROSSSLOT errors in cluster mode, and a failover flush could replay a double refund; switched to Postgres (user decision, t05)
- [essai-raté] Auto-reversal backfill script: rejected — no script touches money; read-only SQL only (t19)
- [décision] Postgres store with unique index on (merchant_id, idempotency_key), not Redis (source: t05)
- [décision] Idempotency TTL of 72 hours, not 24 (source: t09)
